newsitem.title: DENMARK: Knee injury shortens Danish queen's Greenland tour.
newsitem.headline: Knee injury shortens Danish queen's Greenland tour.

text.p: Danish Queen Margrethe cut short a royal visit to Greenland on Wednesday to return to Denmark for treatment of a knee injury.

"It is with great regret that the Queen has been obliged to cut short her visit to Greenland, but the recurrence of an old knee injury problem means that she will be unable to carry out her programme," the Royal Danish court said in a news release.
It said that Queen Margrethe, 57, would fly home for hospital treatment and was due back in Copenhagen on Thursday.
The Danish queen, accompanied by her French husband Prince Henrik, their younger son Prince Joachim and his Hong Kong-born wife Princess Alexandra, arrived in Greenland on August 1.
The visit to Greenland, the world's biggest island with home rule under Denmark, was to have lasted until August 17.
